headline: Why does my soulmate keep slipping past me?
note:
FRAME: soulmate x age band. NO MAN EXISTS YET — she asks WHEN or WHETHER. Must not fall through to decode-him, which would have Evelyn invent a man.
🔴 THE AGE BAND LIVES IN THE AD SET, NEVER IN THE COPY. No age, no number, no life-stage, nothing she could check.
🔴 NO DURATION, forward or back. Every frame bans a DATE; this family's own gap was that 'not much longer' is a LENGTH, and a length is not a date. Nothing here gives one.
⚠ SHE is the subject of beats 3-6; the male figure is described in beats 1-2 and retired there.
⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE anywhere in the read.

⚠ 'KEEP slipping past' lets beat 4 say it has gone that way before — but never how many times.

readback.1 would a person say this: Yes. 'And it's gone that way each time' is her own word back to her.
readback.2 is every noun real: Full table, single rope, mid-step feet — all on the card.
readback.3 anything she could catch me getting wr: No. Beat 4 says nobody stayed and it has happened before. 'Keep' is her ad's word, and no count is attached.
readback.4 does the symbol prove the line at a gl: Yes. Nothing left off the table proves 'you've missed nothing' at a glance.
readback.5 does the card mean what TAROT_CARD_VOC: Yes: will and intention, the pause, new beginnings — none read against itself.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see them, and your hand went to the busiest of the three.
Look at his hands. Both are working, and neither is at rest.
You asked why your soulmate keeps slipping past. What catches me is how much is in motion on this card.
And yet it keeps slipping past you. It has gone this way before.
Something turns up each time this gets close. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what has hold of this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Face down, all three, and you picked the one held at one ankle.
Look at the rope. It holds one ankle, and nothing else touches him.
You asked why your soulmate keeps slipping past. It's the rope I'm reading, and where it runs.
Still, it slips past. And it has gone this way before.
The hold here is light, and it never tightens. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's there…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing marked the backs, and you took the one already walking.
Look at his feet. One is off the ground, and the other is right behind it.
You asked why your soulmate keeps slipping past. The step in this one is still being made.
But it keeps slipping past. And you're the one asking why.
Something is there at the moment things would hold. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind it…
